page.layout: One page of text, one column. Heading "INDEX MATERIARVM." at the top, then the index entries in italic, with a blue underlined passage. "FINIS." and a woodcut ornament below. No margin notes, no page number.

p.i: miatam eripit, quomodo à Saracenis captus ab iisque iterum liberatus sit, p. 385. Baleares insula ipsis à Duce Tarraconensium erepta, p. 386. Hispania Reges discordes. Factio inter Venetos & Genuenses. Christianos Syria pellunt Saraceni. Bodegarus Antiochiam vastat, p. 386. Ludovicus Rex Galliae cum filiis contra Saracenos profisicitur, ejus exercitus peste affligitur, & cum filio Iohanne moritur. Armenii & Scythae ad Gamalem delentur. Tripolis ab Ægyptiis incenditur. Christiani in servitutem abiguntur. Tyrus, Sidon, Tripolis & Berithus ab iisdem complanantur. Ptolemais capta & diruta, p. 388. 389.

page.notes: The first line is a fragment, the start of an entry cut off at the top. The top of the scan has a dark smudge, which is not printed text. The entries from "Ludovicus" to the end are underlined in blue, apparently by a later reader; the underline is not print and is not transcribed. The entry "miatam" begins on the page with the heading placed after it in the reading order, as the heading stands above the text on the scan. Woodcut ornament below FINIS is not text. The heading "INDEX MATERIARVM." is printed above the first entry; the header line order follows the layout of the scan.
